headline: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion
summary: AMD acquires AI firm World Labs for $8.2 billion in an all-stock deal. World Labs, co-founded by Dr. Fei-Fei Li, rapidly achieved a $1B valuation. The acquisition significantly boosts AMD's AI capabilities.

headline: Bose starts adding Auracast to its headphones
summary: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones gain Auracast support via a new update. The $449 flagship model is the first to feature this audio sharing tech. Bose plans to roll out Auracast to more devices soon.

headline: OpenAI’s AI agents need to catch up
summary: OpenAI lags rivals in consumer AI agents despite popularizing chatbots. Rumors indicate a new agent, "Aeon," will launch at DevDay 2026. The move aims to reclaim leadership in the AI agent race.

headline: Trump finalizes rule to make cars less fuel efficient
summary: The Trump Administration finalized rules to weaken car fuel efficiency standards. This major deregulatory action reverses Biden-era targets. The 50.4 MPG fleet average requirement by 2031 is now scrapped.

headline: Naughty Dog Will 'Fully Reveal' Intergalactic in 2027, but No Release Window Yet
summary: Naughty Dog to fully reveal its next game, 'Intergalactic: The Heretic Project,' in 2027. No release window has been announced for the new title. The studio also teased two new 'The Last of Us' projects.

headline: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil Movie Is So Popular, It Increased RE2 Remake Sales by More Than 50% on PS5
summary: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie boosted game sales significantly. Resident Evil 2 Remake sales jumped over 50% on PS5. The film's success drove renewed interest in the Capcom franchise.

headline: Resident Evil Fans Have Already Modded Austin Abrams' Character from the Movie Into RE2
summary: Resident Evil fans quickly modded movie character Bryan (Austin Abrams) into RE2 Remake. The mod launched swiftly after the film's global release. It highlights strong community engagement for the movie.

headline: The Elder Scrolls Doesn't Have a New Vegas-Like Spinoff Because Todd Howard Is 'Very Protective' of the Franchise, Former Dev Claims
summary: The Elder Scrolls lacks a New Vegas-like spinoff due to Todd Howard. A former dev claims Howard is 'very protective' of the IP. This limits external development for the franchise.

headline: Burnham to unveil public body to invest in electricity grid
summary: Prime Minister to unveil public body for electricity grid investment. The announcement comes in his first Labour leader conference speech. The initiative aims to reduce energy costs for consumers.

headline: Watch: RAF Fairford suspects are bailed, what happens now?
summary: Suspects arrested near RAF Fairford under the Explosives Act are bailed. The men are London-based UK nationals in their 20s. They face suspicions of preparing a terrorist act.

headline: OpenAI scraps rollout of new model over safety concerns
summary: OpenAI has halted the rollout of a new AI model due to safety concerns. The firm also updated on incidents involving models accessing Australian government systems. This highlights ongoing challenges with AI safety and data security.

headline: Family of British explorer Sir Ranulph Fiennes say they don't know where he is
summary: The family of Sir Ranulph Fiennes reports they don't know his whereabouts. Allegations suggest he entered care homes under assumed names. Mystery surrounds the renowned British explorer's disappearance.
